Content / items: Grammar 4 items (one per sampled A1 section) + vocabulary 4 items (Oxford A1 entries in context) + reading 1 text (40–60 words) with 2 items
Decision rule: Level mastered if grammar ≥70%, vocabulary ≥70% and global ≥80% → go to next level; otherwise stop: placement level = A1.

Content / items: Same structure with A2 sections and entries; reading 60–90 words
Same structure with B1 sections and entries; reading 90–120 words
Same structure with B2 sections and entries; reading 120–150 words
Same structure with C1 sections and entries; reading 150–180 words
Decision rule: If C1 is mastered, placement level = C1 and stage 2 still runs in C1.

Content / items: Writing: one short task of that level (lower bound of its word range). Speaking: voice agent in exam mode, 2 min, situation of that level
Decision rule: Scored with exit rubrics RB-XW/RB-XS. If Writing or Speaking <70%, the placement level drops one level (minimum A1).

Content / items: Probe of one content unit: grammar 5 items on the unit section + vocabulary 6 items sampled from the unit's lesson entries (meaning and use in context)
Decision rule: Unit mastered if grammar ≥70% (≥4/5), vocabulary ≥70% (≥5/6) and global ≥80% (≥9/11).

Content / items: Code chooses the units to probe by binary search over the content units of the level in Course seq order (A1 14, A2 11, B1 13, B2 17, C1 12 content units → ≤5 probes), then one confirmation probe of the unit before the first non-mastered unit
Decision rule: Assumes mastery follows the course order. Start lesson = first lesson of the first content unit not mastered; if all are mastered, start at the level final review.

Content / items: Post-placement reinforcement session (P18): failed sections and words inside credited units + REQUIRED prerequisites of the start lesson
Decision rule: Formative, not scored. Then the learner starts the start lesson.

Content / items: Items generated on demand by the tutor agent from Grammar Sections, Grammar_Subpoints and Vocabulary; scored by the evaluator; decisions computed by code. Language: English only.
Decision rule: Credit by placement: P17. Re-placement: P19. Texts reusable up to 3 times per learner, items always new (P08).
